verdict.rationale: Belvo is an API platform, so bulk or batch operations are a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence documents no bulk or batch endpoint for acting on many links, accounts or payments at once. Paginated List requests of up to 1000 results only read data rather than perform bulk actions, and per-link automatic weekly refreshes and async POST calls are adjacent features, not a bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
